title: The penicillin
description: You can now revive your friends in HARDCORE servers... or could you?
body:
# THE PENICILLIN

A hardcore revive plugin for Paper/Purpur servers.

→ Features

* Revive dead spectator and online players
* Works with respawn points
* Enhance Hardcore gameplay with friends
* You can craft it
* Small GUI
* A revive item
* You can craft stacks of them

→ Crafting Recipe


Diamond Block | Enchanted Golden Apple | Diamond Block

Diamond Block | Wither Skeleton Skull  | Diamond Block

Diamond Block | Diamond Block          | Diamond Block


![The recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/107cbf026d23dd5bd4cb4d83bad291bf7c846649.png) 

→ How it looks in your hand

![The penicillin](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/515bfc091a84f5e6f5219c9364331edca5b974c4.png)


→ Usage


Right click THE PENICILLIN and choose a dead player to revive.


![Make your choice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cbe41b665c9858424d3fd346abe08d686ba0b7a9.png)
